name: Patience is a Virtue
source:
It's just another rehearsal for Rose and Mariella, playing one of Mariella's own compositions yet again. Has it been one too many, or just another day with her? Rose asks herself if this friendship she kept with the most talented girl she knew really was worth it in the end... Is she even enjoying this at all?
